title: Peter the Great founds Saint Petersburg
summary: Peter the Great laid the foundation of the Peter and Paul Fortress on an island in the Neva delta, the beginning of Saint Petersburg.
reason: Peter had just won the Neva mouth from Sweden and wanted a port and a new capital facing Europe.
significance: Saint Petersburg became the capital of Russia for two centuries and its window to the West.
place: Peter and Paul Fortress, Saint Petersburg, Russia
